rubricDispositions.rationale: The task packet hash matches the proof packet and the implementation targets the approved S08-T03 review-first classification scope.
The workflow commit path can produce required classification failures that are not declared in the workflow contract.
Durable table schemas include the canonical classification states, generation fields, effect keys, and required indexes for this lane.
The proof packet records the required pattern-instance generator commands and focused gates, including package-local classification, web review queue, and Confect/headless/layer checks.
Changed files are within the manifest-owned S08-T03 inventory; generated Confect/Convex checked-tree omissions remain integration-owned per the review instructions and packet.
Declared typed errors do not cover all task-required workflow failure paths.

findings.summary: Workflow contract omits task-required review and commit typed failures.
findings.details: S08-T03 requires typed errors MalformedModelOutput, TargetNotAllowed, EvidenceMismatch, ReviewForbidden, StaleGeneration, and DuplicateEffect for the review-first classification flow. The capability spec declares only the model-validation subset, while the workflow contract exposes only generic Unauthorized/member/workspace/not-found/validation errors. The workflow routes reviewed classifications into routes.commit, and the task-owned helpers define ReviewForbidden, StaleGeneration, and DuplicateEffect as reachable failures, but those failures are not represented in the workflow expected-error contract. Callers therefore cannot distinguish non-admin review, stale generation fences, or duplicate route effects as the task contract requires.
